name: How does appliance placement influence the design and cost of a custom kitchen renovation?

mainEntity.name: How does appliance placement influence the design and cost of a custom kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Appliance placement significantly influences both the design and cost of a custom kitchen renovation. Strategically locating major appliances impacts workflow, cabinet configurations, and the necessity for specific utility runs (electrical, gas, water, ventilation). For instance, moving a refrigerator or range might require extending or relocating plumbing and gas lines, or adding new dedicated electrical circuits, which adds to the project's complexity and material costs. Our design-build approach prioritizes value engineering and functionality, ensuring that appliance layout enhances your kitchen's efficiency and aesthetic appeal while considering the most effective use of resources to achieve your vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Appliance placement impacts kitchen design, workflow, and renovation costs by dictating utility runs, cabinetry, and structural needs.
